test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Meera wanted to prove to those around her that she was not __a fair-weather friend.__
solution: ```html The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Unreliable friend in difficult times. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"fair-weather friend"** refers to someone who is only a friend when circumstances are pleasant and will not support you in times of trouble. (मौसमी दोस्त) • **Example:** When he lost his job, he realized that most of his so-called friends were just fair-weather friends. • **"Reliable friend in tough times"** refers to someone who remains supportive and loyal even in difficult situations. (कठिन समय में विश्वसनीय मित्र) • **Example:** She was a reliable friend in tough times, always there to offer support and help when needed. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Unreliable friend in difficult times. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Friend for all situations **(सभी परिस्थितियों के लिए मित्र): Someone who is supportive and present in every situation. • **Example:** A true friend for all situations will stand by you no matter what life throws at you. • **Helping and caring companion **(मददगार और देखभाल करने वाला साथी ): Someone who is always ready to help and care for you. • **Example: **She was known as a helping and caring companion, always putting others' needs before her own. • **Reliable friend in tough times** (कठिन समय में विश्वसनीय मित्र): Someone who remains supportive and loyal even in difficult situations. • **Example:** He proved to be a reliable friend in tough times when he helped me through my illness. Question: Meera wanted to prove to those around her that she was not a fair-weather friend. The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Unreliable friend in difficult times. ``` 110:T963, ```html The correct answer is **Option 3**.
